summary: Analyzes and visualizes gene expression trends across developmental time points in neural lineages, classifying markers into Up, Transient, Down, or Constant trajectory patterns.
use_when: How do I plot developmental trajectories for marker genes in mouse visual cortex?
Categorize gene expression into up-regulated or transient trends during development
Visualize lineage-specific gene dynamics using smoothed trajectory modeling
Script to classify scRNA-seq markers as constant or transient over time
Generate temporal expression heatmaps for excitatory and inhibitory cell lineages
avoid_when: The intended conclusion requires causal inference from an observational association alone
